name: Autopilot Watch
tagline: We watch your site, measure it, and tell you exactly what to fix. We change nothing.
priceNote: per site, per month. No contract.
bestFor: Businesses with their own web person, who need to know what to fix first rather than who fixes it.
includes: Your first full report within five working days
Daily check for links that lead nowhere, error pages, and pages Google cannot see
How fast your pages really are for real visitors, measured against Google's standards
A check that the hidden labels describing your pages are working
Which AI assistants are reading your site, and which pages they looked at
One weekly email with a plain list of what to fix, in the order that matters most
Every item comes with the exact change needed, so your developer can just do it
excludes: Nothing on your site is changed

name: Autopilot Apply
tagline: We fix the safe, mechanical things ourselves. Anything involving your words comes to you first.
priceNote: per site, per month. Cancel any time; the site stays yours.
bestFor: Owners who want the endless small jobs to stop landing on their desk, without losing control of what the site says.
includes: Everything in Watch
Week one is deliberately visible: speed, broken links and errors fixed first
Before we touch anything we take a full copy of your site as it is today, kept for as long as you are a client
We fix the safe things ourselves — links, page lists, pictures, labels and speed
Anything that changes your wording is sent to you to approve before it goes live
Every change is separate and dated, so any one of them can be undone on its own
Putting a previous version back takes seconds, not a rebuild
A running list of every change made, which you can keep private or publish
One instruction stops everything, immediately
Leaving? Keep our improvements, or ask for your original site back exactly as it was. Your choice
excludes: No content or layout testing against a comparison group

name: Autopilot Compound
tagline: We improve the words and the layout, and prove it worked by comparing against pages we left alone.
priceNote: per site, per month. Three months minimum, because proving it works takes that long.
cadence: Checked daily, changes weekly, results monthly
bestFor: Businesses where being found and getting enquiries is a real part of the income, and small gains add up.
includes: Everything in Apply
Before we touch anything we take a full copy of your site as it is today, kept for as long as you are a client
We deliberately leave a group of similar pages untouched, to compare against
Better wording and clearer answers, aimed at getting quoted by AI assistants
Testing on buttons, layout and forms to turn more visitors into enquiries
A monthly result showing the difference against the untouched pages — including the losses
Pages built for questions people already ask you but your site does not answer
If the untouched pages beat ours two months running, that month is free
excludes: Not sold to sites under about 30 similar pages — a fair comparison needs enough of them
